description: Mesure de la fréquentation quotidienne vélo par les capteurs ZELT is a dataset listed in opendata.clermontmetropole.eu open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Clermont Auvergne Métropole. Mesure de la fréquentation quotidienne vélo par les capteurs ZELT. Ces compteurs sont pourvus de capteurs de type zelt. Il s'agit de boucles de comptage électromagnétiques implantées sous la chaussée permettant de déterminer le nombre de passage en vélos et de distinguer les sens de circulation. Coverage: Clermont Auvergne Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are vélo, mobilité douce, sport. The portal shows 6,274 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermontmetropole-eu-portal.
